fact-list.$description: Tokens for FactList: label / value rows (decision 47). Measured from the audit's capture of the retail property page's facts (F21 Key-value fact row; desktop 1700px, phone 400px).

font-size.$description: OBSERVED: 20px labels and values, on desktop and phone; became 18px, the nearest size on the system's scale.

font-weight.$description: OBSERVED: labels at weight 100 and values at 400; both 400 now (decision 4: two weights), so the label's colour marks it, as on Tabs.

label.$description: OBSERVED: black labels in a thin weight; became the secondary grey (#63666a, 5.77:1 on white) at regular weight, so labels read lighter than values without a thin font.

row-gap.$description: OBSERVED: 8px under each row (32px rows of 24px text).

pair-gap.$description: PROPOSED: 24px between the two pairs on a row. AcmeCo's pairs touch (two 628px halves), and a long value runs into the next label.
